query: What criteria should guide trade-offs among privacy techniques (federated learning, differential privacy, geo-anonymization, synthetic data) to preserve analytical utility and reduce re-identification risk?

response.query: What criteria should guide trade-offs among privacy techniques (federated learning, differential privacy, geo-anonymization, synthetic data) to preserve analytical utility and reduce re-identification risk?
response.answer: Trade-offs among privacy techniques should prioritize analytical utility and minimize re-identification risk, balancing privacy with data usability. Federated learning and differential privacy focus on protecting individual data while maintaining model accuracy. Synthetic data and geo-anonymization aim to preserve privacy while ensuring data utility.
